program_name: First Nations Finance Authority Financing Program
amount_notes: Pooled borrowing model. Loan amounts determined by pledged revenues. FNFA provides loans not grants. Interest rates comparable to Ontario government borrowing rates.
organization_types_eligible: First Nation governments that are FNFA members
Bodies providing services to First Nation communities
eligibility_criteria: Must be a recognized First Nation government or FNFA member
Must have eligible revenues to pledge against financing
Must meet FNFA governance and financial management standards
Projects must be for community infrastructure or economic development
exclusions: CRITICAL: This is a loan program not a grant — full repayment required
Not-for-profit organizations not eligible — First Nation governments only
Emerge Academy and similar NFP organizations are not eligible applicants
notes: DATABASE CORRECTION: The FNFA Community Development Fund listed in original PathGrant reports does not exist. FNFA provides financing to First Nation governments only — not grants to NFP organizations. Will appear in FINANCING section only. Not applicable to Emerge Academy. Relevant only if a client is a First Nation government seeking infrastructure financing.
